data.body: **[P1] Finalize shutdown-time plugin fatals before releasing instances.** This check runs only after the manager has closed. A fatal reported while `ExecutionManager.close()` drains work therefore arrives after `onInvocationEnd` emitted `PENDING` or `SUCCEEDED` and after plugins were released, so telemetry records a stale outcome even though the invocation fails. Determine the final outcome before the single end-hook dispatch, release plugins afterward, and make the shutdown-fatal test expect one `RETRYING` event carrying the fatal.
